entries.name: Manor
entries.content:
The manor is a grandiose structure, standing proudly amidst the vast expanse of greenery surrounding it. Its stone walls are covered in ivy, giving it a charming, rustic appearance. The towering double doors at the entrance are intricately carved with elegant designs, hinting at the opulence that lies beyond them.

Stepping inside, one is greeted by a spacious foyer, adorned with exquisite furniture and tasteful decorations. To the right is a sweeping staircase, leading to the upper floors where most of the living quarters are located. To the left, a long hallway stretches out, leading to various rooms including the dining room, library, and drawing room.

Straight ahead, past the foot of the stairs, is a pair of wooden doors that open into the expansive kitchen. Sunlight streams in through large windows, casting warm rays across the tiled floor. Various pots and pans hang from hooks above a large island counter, reflecting the skill and expertise of the cook who works tirelessly to prepare meals for the residents.

Beyond the kitchen, a set of glass doors lead out onto a sprawling terrace, offering breathtaking views of the gardens below. Stone pathways weave through meticulously maintained flower beds, lined with colorful blooms and neatly trimmed hedges. Statues dot the landscape, adding an air of elegance to the serene setting.

As majestic as the exterior may be, the interior of the manor is equally impressive, filled with comfortable seating areas, cozy fireplaces, and inviting nooks designed for relaxation and conversation.
